allowed_changes: monthly review at first execution session
strictly prior-date BAA10Y with <=7 calendar-day staleness
risk-on when current BAA10Y <= value 20 source observations earlier
risk-on owner 100% Nasdaq; other state owner 100% gold
fixed annual-rebalanced 50/50 Nasdaq-gold barbell and cash controls

follow_up_policy: After formal metrics are viewed, no BAA lookback, threshold, source, owner, cadence, hysteresis, weighting, fee or confirmation-filter rescue is allowed in this lineage.

using HYOAS or replacing BAA10Y after results
adding momentum, VIX, curve, NFCI, volatility or trend filters
changing owners, weights, monthly cadence or hysteresis
shorting, leverage, financing, gross >100% or negative cash
hypothesis: Changes in the Baa corporate bond spread versus Treasuries reflect the direction of financing stress. When the strictly prior-date BAA10Y spread is no higher than 20 source observations earlier, credit conditions are easing and growth equities should be favored; when the spread is widening, gold should provide a more resilient owner. A monthly owner-change-only rotation can use this external credit cycle while keeping turnover low and avoiding price-direction signals.
pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0
selection_metric: Reuse exact frozen F-BAA 20-observation falling-state semantics; no lookback/source/threshold search. Validation, objective and barbell comparison remain independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.
